headline: Machine Learning Engineer at Corvo Robotics | Computer vision for farm robots
summary: I teach robots to tell a ripe tomato from a green one. My work sits between research and production: I take vision models from papers and make them run on small, cheap hardware in muddy fields.

experiences.title: Machine Learning Engineer
experiences.description: Builds the fruit-detection models for a harvesting robot. Shrank the main model to run at 15 frames per second on an embedded board without losing accuracy.

experiences.title: Research Intern
experiences.description: Worked on data-efficient object detection with synthetic images.

education.description: Thesis: detecting small objects in cluttered outdoor scenes.

volunteer_work.description: Runs Saturday robotics and coding workshops for children aged 9 to 13.

projects.title: Orchard-Mini dataset
projects.description: Released a public dataset of 6,000 labelled fruit images from orchards.
